messages:
Alexa: Quick question — for private sidecars vs hosted proxies, how should we negotiate runtime capability sets so we don't hit hard failures at request time?
Mike: +1 to formalizing. My take: attach-time capability probe + manifest labels. If capability missing, use explicit fallback policy (model variant / quantized path / reject).
Priya: Could you show a tiny example manifest?
Mike: Sure — something like:
```yaml
service: runtime-agent
capabilities: [kv_cache, prefix_cache, hsm]
fallback: { hsm: fallthrough_to_software_kms, kv_cache: allow_partial_cache }
version: 2026-03-01
```
Priya: Nice. So controller should read that and synthesize routing predicates?
Sanjay: Also: observability must record which fallback was used (metric + trace tag) so product teams can triage regressions. And map KMS permission failures -> 4xx/403 flavor, not 5xx.
Alexa: How about upgrades / eviction race-conditions? If a sidecar claims new capability mid-rollout, we might route requests there prematurely.
Mike: We should gate capability activation behind a handshake: node registers with claimed capability but stays in "candidate" state until probe passes for N minutes and we see healthy traces. Only then flip to "active". Canary policy for new capability.
Priya: Perf note: private sidecars often lack the batching hardware of hosted. The fallback policy should prefer a cheaper model variant with shorter KV cache windows rather than forcing slower throughput.
Sanjay: Agree. Also add a runtime flag to prefer deterministic latency (reject batch) vs prefer throughput (buffer). We can expose it as route-level hint.
Alexa: Sounds good. Who owns the RFC?
Mike: I can draft an RFC. Plan: define capability schema, probe protocol (HTTP /healthcap), handshake state machine (candidate->active->deprecated), and observability events; add examples for KMS and batching fallbacks.
Priya: Add a small scheduler test plan: simulate hosted proxy with missing HSM and ensure fallback path returns expected codes and metrics.
Sanjay: And include a migration checklist for Dedicated -> Private (how to re-label nodes, backfill manifests).
infra-bot: deploy-bot: note — rolling canary infra exists at infra/canaries/capability-gate. Trigger with `/deploy canary capability-gate`
Alexa: Great. Mike, drop a PR to arch board and assign reviewers (Priya + Sanjay). :thumbsup:
Mike: Will do. I'll target a short RFC and a follow-up implementation issue.
